say:0:1460484001:1.text: After investigation, you've finally understood the real cause behind this strange outbreak.
say:0:1460484001:1.source_cn: 根据你的调查，你已经知晓了这次奇妙病症广泛发作的原因。

say:1:1460484002:1.text: And with your experience patching up half the city, a new idea begins to take shape in your mind!
say:1:1460484002:1.source_cn: 而凭借长期治疗的经验与自身的智慧，你产生了全新的灵感！

say:2:1460484003:1.text: No need for strict recipes. Just toss in <style="highlight">whatever herbs</style> you've got, adjust the dose and timing by instinct, and you'll end up with something useful!
say:2:1460484003:1.source_cn: 你只需要使用<style=highlight>任意药材...

say:3:1460484004:1.text: It might not be the strongest cure around, but it should work on just about <style="highlight">anything</style> and anyone.
say:3:1460484004:1.source_cn: 尽管它的总体疗效有限，但好就好在能够任意搭配，对<st...

say:4:1460484005:1.text: And on a <style="highlight">lucky</style> day, it might even come out <style="highlight">extra potent</style> and fix everything in one go!

narration:5:1460484006:0.text: You've learned the recipes for <style="highlight">Average Aid</style> and <style="highlight">Universal Panacea</style>!
